subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should OpenClaw land the narrow sanitized core status-label display fix now, and should it come from the open cross-repo PR or a new upstream repair?
rationale: The issue is valid on current main, but the open linked PR is conflicting and stale while the requested display precedence and sanitization affect shared CLI/TUI status behavior.

options.title: Adopt a narrow upstream fix
options.body: Land a focused core change that propagates sanitized label/displayName through status rows and closes or supersedes the conflicting cross-repo PR.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the cross-repo PR author to rebase, add terminal-safe rendering, and provide real behavior proof.

options.title: Defer to broader attribution work
options.body: Leave this issue open as product-direction input for the broader status/usage attribution request, accepting that UUID-heavy CLI/TUI status remains for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow upstream fix
recommendation.body: Land a focused core change that propagates sanitized label/displayName through status rows and closes or supersedes the conflicting cross-repo PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses recent status, TUI, cron/session, and session-thread work where this owner has the strongest recent path history.
